verdict.rationale: Luma's own materials describe Luma Agents built into its browser-based creative workspace that research, generate, and refine multi-step video, image, audio, and text work, plus Luma Skills for reusable creative workflows. This is a first-party, in-product agent users can hand tasks to. The support rests on brief marketing lines with no detail on how delegation works and no hands-on confirmation. missing for 10: in-depth docs on how users assign and steer agent tasks, documented agent controls or limits, independent or hands-on corroboration of agent delegation.
